record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Study the properties of multigraded regularity for multigraded rings, ideals, and modules.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $k$, equipped with a multigrading by a finitely generated abelian group $A$ (so each variable $x_i$ is assigned a degree $a_i \in A$, and $\deg$ extends multiplicatively to monomials). Let $B \subseteq S$ be an irrelevant ideal (for example, the irrelevant ideal of a smooth projective toric variety whose Cox ring is $S$). For a finitely generated $A$-graded $S$-module $M$, the local cohomology modules $H^i_B(M)$ are again $A$-graded, and one may define the multigraded Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity $\operatorname{reg}(M) \subseteq A$ (as a subset, or "regularity region," of the grading group) by requiring that for every $i$ and every $\mathbf{p} \in \operatorname{reg}(M)$, the degree-$\mathbf{q}$ piece of $H^i_B(M)$ vanishes for all $\mathbf{q}$ in a prescribed translate of $\mathbf{p}$ depending on $i$.

Investigate the structural properties of this multigraded regularity region. In particular:

(a) Develop intrinsic characterizations of $\operatorname{reg}(M)$ in terms of the shifts appearing in a minimal multigraded free resolution of $M$, generalizing the classical equivalence between cohomological and resolution-theoretic definitions of regularity in the standard $\mathbb{Z}$-graded setting.

(b) Establish sharp bounds relating $\operatorname{reg}(M)$, $\operatorname{reg}(S/I)$, and $\operatorname{reg}(I)$ for an $A$-graded ideal $I \subseteq S$, including behavior under standard operations (sums, products, intersections, quotients, tensor products, and short exact sequences).

(c) Determine effective algorithms, in terms of Gröbner bases with respect to multigraded term orders, for computing $\operatorname{reg}(M)$ and for producing generators of $M$ in prescribed multidegrees lying in $\operatorname{reg}(M)$.

(d) Identify natural classes of multigraded rings, ideals, and modules (e.g., Stanley–Reisner ideals of simplicial complexes with multigradings, edge ideals of bipartite graphs, modules of equivariant sheaves on toric varieties) for which $\operatorname{reg}(M)$ admits a combinatorial or polyhedral description.
artifact.status_search_result: Multigraded Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity remains an active research topic. The foundational definition (Maclagan–Smith) has been extended and refined, with recent work on Klyachko filtrations (2021), Gröbner basis characterizations (2024), and sharp resolution-theoretic bounds. The problem is open-ended by nature, and many specific questions about computing and bounding multigraded regularity remain only partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: Multigraded Castelnuovo-Mumford Regularity (Maclagan–Smith)
status_evidence.snippet: A multigraded variant of Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity is developed for modules over a polynomial ring graded by a finitely generated abelian group.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational definition; subsequent extensions and open directions continue to appear.

status_evidence.title: Multigraded Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity via Klyachko filtrations
status_evidence.snippet: Z^r-graded modules on Cox rings of smooth complete toric varieties via Klyachko filtrations and lattice polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2021) partial progress on the structure of multigraded regularity.

status_evidence.title: Multigraded Castelnuovo-Mumford Regularity and Gröbner bases
status_evidence.snippet: Relation between multigraded Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity of a multihomogeneous ideal and minimal Gröbner bases.
status_evidence.claim: Active 2024 research showing the topic remains open and developing.

status_evidence.title: Castelnuovo Mumford regularity with respect to multigraded ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Extension over arbitrary base rings and irrelevant ideals B.
